assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:reala-thompson@light-novel#character-model, the canonical generation V1.0 Reala V01-V21 source-bounded character model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels; the model declares that it was built from targeted revisits of already consumed V13, V14, V17, V19, V20 and V21 (27 bounded deliveries, one V19 image viewed that supplies no Reala portrait or action), that the V01-V21 label is a horizon rather than an appearance in every volume, that the V13 earlier mother is a trial-mediated reconstructive plane and the V17 rescue and naming history is Gallek's report, and that V19-V20 material is indirect family context only. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method, authority order and gate state only. The frozen volume readings, the master, event, knowledge, mechanics, institution and relationship ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Reala fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; V22 and later, EX, IF, web-novel, supplement, translation and adaptation material is excluded.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's default D4b, the V21 Pristella child-audience coda five days after the city battle and two days after Subaru's party leaves (routed to E021 common prior history, not the global E024 tower state), with Gallek preserved in ice and her recovered memory contents unreported, plus its explicitly selectable earlier phases: D1 the trial-mediated earlier mother before the accident (V13), D2 Gallek's reported rescue, waking and naming, D3 the V17 Pristella household visit and the city-crisis request, and D4a the V21 post-battle visit before Garfiel leaves. Her age is an adult phase without a birthday, the attributed fifteen-year and ten-plus-year clocks stay open, and nothing after the V21 coda is assessed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1 states a governing reading (she makes another person's presence usable through ordinary acts and understands herself through sustaining a household and believing a future remains possible, which can lead to costly giving), records topic-bound rather than global self-deprecation and hope that coexists with visible fear, and tests five rival accounts (limitless mother, harmless optimist, fully restored and staging, no recognition beyond generic instinct, affection cancelled by concealment) against discriminating evidence; section 4 gives twenty conditional rules (10 HIGH, 10 MEDIUM). Her motives are inferred from her speech and conduct in essentially two household visits and a trial-mediated scene, section 12 abstains on a complete departure or concealment rationale (INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED), and her recovered memory contents are unknown, so B is not supported; the rival testing and rule structure exceed a distributed collection of scenes, so D is not supported.

Section 2 maps five selectable phases (D1 trial-mediated earlier mother, D2 reported rescue and naming, D3 V17 household and crisis, D4a V21 visit, D4b default coda) with transfer gates and seven coordinates, and the evidence shows located change: the V17 trembling request (E15) against the V21 stated hope with unknown timing (E21, E26), Gallek's transformation and preservation (E22), and the coda's love address to Garf complicating Garfiel's earlier no-recognition conclusion (E24, E26). Each present phase rests on one extended scene, D1 is a reconstructive trial plane and D2 is Gallek's report, the approximate clocks stay open and the change across the memory break has no identified mechanism, so B is not supported; the phases are explicit, located and firewalled, so D is not supported.

Section 8 locates fifteen forms with phase, recipient and function: earlier フーちゃん/ガーちゃん and お母さんドジ (V13 p-025), present 私 with polite questions and apologies, 触ってもいいかしら, 怒るわよ/離しなさい, ごめんなさい/忘れてください, 驚かせてしまいましたか/もう、あの人ったら, 二人の子どものお母さん, the shift from ゴージャス・タイガーさん to ガーフィール/ガーフ after Mimi supplies the name, ラフィ→ラフィール, わからない/必ず and 愛しているわ、ガーフ. There is no sentence-ending or lexical inventory, the forms come from a few scenes, and the model returns JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW for unsupported lines, so B is not supported; the forms are located and recipient-conditioned, so D is not supported.

Section 5 locates ordinary conduct across ten responsibilities: hosting, seating and tea with a late preference check (E06, R01-R02), homemade Sowarie offered with confidence and praised (E13, R07), the asked-for ear touch (E08), considering money as thanks and later giving goods and savings (E09, E20), correcting children and insisting on a farewell (R05), and the amnesia startle question (E21). The mundane gaps are explicit (no birthday, timetable, wage, employment history, favorite tea or food, leisure, sleep or time alone), and the ordinary scenes concentrate in the V17 and V21 household visits, so B is not supported; the conduct is located, recurs across both visits and is ruled with HIGH rules, so D is not supported.

Section 6 differentiates seven relations with reciprocal agency and transfer bounds (Gallek, Garfiel, Mimi, Rafiel, Fredo, the trial-represented Frederica and Ryuzu, community or unknown recipients) and a family-knowledge table separating what the analyst, Reala, the children, Garfiel and Frederica each receive; R04 contrasts the permission-asked ear touch with Mimi against the initiated head touch for distressed Garfiel, and R05 separates Rafiel's resource objection from Fredo's clinging. Each present relation rests on one or two scenes, the earlier relations are trial-mediated, the stranger case is unsupplied and the matched-recipient families MR01-MR03 are probe designs rather than observed contrasts, so B is not supported; recipient-specific conduct is located with stated exceptions, so D is not supported.

Reala's inner states reach the reader through her own speech and others' perception: her stated view that anxiety can let happiness slip away (E21), trembling hands and pallor during the crisis request seen by the visitors (E15), the visible softening at Gallek's look (E10), and the coda's tears, mixed sadness and hope and forgotten-item remark heard by the children (E26). The model presents no scene focalized through Reala, keeps the V17 background as attributed history rather than her testimony (E04), and marks her recovered memory contents and complete motive unknown, so C is not supported; located spoken affect across phases exceeds E.

Conflict is mild and household-scale but located in distinct types: rebuking the daughter's unfair accusation and gently undoing Fredo's grip (E09), escalating from ラフィ to ラフィール when a farewell is refused (E25), holding back the children's competing claims (E24, R15), explaining costly giving against Rafiel's objection and Garfiel's challenge (E20, R08 MEDIUM), asking for help and withdrawing at hesitation (E15, R09 MEDIUM), and light acknowledgment of criticism (section 9). Correction recurs across both visits with a HIGH rule, so D is not supported; the resource dispute and the crisis request are single episodes, no hostile confrontation or response to a new refusal is shown, and section 9 declines to predict her response to a severe accusation, so B is not supported.

Value choices are located but rarely weighed in her voice: she explains costly civic giving through mutual support while minimizing its cost and framing fewer possessions as relief (E20, R08 MEDIUM), states that Gallek's return in his changed form could be acceptable if he did not mind (E22, R11), and the narrator attributes the ice preservation to the couple's joint decision (R12). The model says one post-crisis episode cannot determine the next resource conflict, P02 rejects a categorical prediction of giving or refusing, and P03 abstains on certifying treatment for another patient. A stated principle and a conditional acceptance without explicit weighing of her household's need do not support C; the choices are located and ruled, so E is not supported.

Play is located but thin: the amnesia startle question and mild disappointment that Gallek already told the guest (E21, R17 MEDIUM, with the stock-routine reading kept as Garfiel's qualified inference), the unexpectedly positive appraisal of Gallek's dragon form (E22), tactile pleasure at Mimi's ears (E08), delight at praise of the names she chose (E25) and light acknowledgment of criticism of the family's lack of caution (section 9). Humor rests on essentially one exchange and is not analyzed as a register, so C is not supported; the instances are located across V17 and V21 and bounded by NC12, so E is not supported.

Section 0 declares the admitted Japanese V01-V21 horizon and exclusions, records 27 bounded deliveries across V13, V14, V17, V19, V20 and V21 with position and ruby counts and one viewed image, routes 26 bundles E01-E26 to exact native block ranges, and applies the SA01 actor correction against the original. The model states the counts are navigation, not fresh whole-volume rereads; the readings, ledgers, source lock and EPUBs are outside this evidence set; her present-life evidence concentrates in V17 p-005 and V21 part0015; and the series continues past V21 with her memory contents unreported, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limits and contradictions: tea prepared before asking a preference (E06), the Sowarie gift intensifying Garfiel's pain in a context she does not know (E12-E14), trembling and an inadequate own search during the crisis (E15), Rafiel's material objection and reduced possessions (E20), her nonreceipt of the Gallek-Garfiel private conversation (E12), the explicit two-child self-count against four biological children (section 6), Emilia rather than Reala performing the preservation (E22), the SA01 correction that Reala, not Rafiel, delivers the introduction, and twenty-six adverse controls NC01-NC26 rejecting false inferences in both directions. All of it lives in one same-analyst artifact whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

The default is fixed at the V21 coda, battle plus five days and Subaru's departure plus two, routed to E021 common prior history and kept distinct from the global E024 tower state (section 0, E18); every earlier phase is selectable with knowledge firewalls: she does not receive Gallek's private question or Garfiel's denial (E12, NC18), absent Garfiel and Mimi do not receive the coda (NC21), the children are not told the full genealogy, the trial-represented Frederica is a proxy (NC04), and preserved Gallek supplies no awake reply (NC16). No birthday is fixed and the attributed fifteen-year and ten-plus-year clocks stay open (NC02), so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

conditions: A phase is selected explicitly; D1 is used only as the trial-represented plane, and at the D4b default any new exchange is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE with her recovered memory contents left unknown.

Output reproduces the section 8 speech functions for an attested recipient in paraphrase; exact Japanese is cited only from a located passage, and an unsupported voice line returns JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW rather than an invented catchphrase.
Address follows the attested shift: polite guest titles before Mimi supplies the full name, personal ガーフ address only after it; Reala, not Rafiel, delivers the children's introduction (SA01).
Preserved Gallek gives no new awake reply unless a hypothetical waking is explicitly stipulated and labeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 8 supplies located, recipient-conditioned forms and the instruction to select relation and purpose before wording, and G01-G02 govern speaker, audience and endpoint. READY would treat fifteen short forms from a few scenes as a voice inventory; NOT_READY would deny the located, phase- and recipient-conditioned speech acts the model supports. This bounds the evidence set, not Reala's speech.

conditions: A source-bounded phase is named; D1 and D2 are selected only as the trial-represented or reported planes they are, never as present memory.
The interlocutor is an attested relation in the register and knowledge the phase allows; an unfamiliar person inherits no maternal intimacy, permission or family history.
Neither total ignorance nor full memory restoration is assumed after the coda; the forgotten item and recognition contents stay unknown.
Output is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, keeps MEDIUM rules conditional and settles no resource allocation, cure, cohabitation or family disclosure.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named phase: D1 the V13 trial-represented earlier mother, D3 the V17 Pristella household visit or city-crisis request, D4a the V21 post-battle visit, or the D4b V21 child-audience coda default; nothing after the V21 coda.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Gallek as spouse (awake only in D3/D4a or under a labeled hypothetical waking); Garfiel as V17 rescuer-guest or V21 familiar visitor without a delivered genealogy; Mimi as guest; Rafiel and Fredo as her children with distinct positions; Frederica and Ryuzu only in the D1 trial plane; unfamiliar visitors without shared history.
setting_constraints: The Pristella household, the post-battle mutual-aid city and the trial-represented sanctuary departure
No combat role, ice magic, medical authority, political office or patient-surrogate power
No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese V01-V21 main light novels
Open domains end in the model's section 12 abstentions rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section 11 gives three matched-recipient families, six unfamiliar cases and two source-adjacent calibrations, all labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, and section 12 lists abstentions and revision triggers. Readiness is conditional because half the rules are MEDIUM, interiority comes only through speech and others' perception, each present phase rests on one scene and the only test of the model is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review outside this evidence set. READY would treat probe design as validation; NOT_READY would deny an explicit, state-bound application protocol.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: hosting and tea, homemade sweets, guest arrival and departure, children's correction and farewell, and post-crisis visits.
No favorite tea or food, timetable, wage, employment, leisure or full household division of labor is supplied.
Resources are finite and household members can disagree; welcome is not unlimited supply or danger-blind admission.
Missing routines are not turned into evidence that she lacks them.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary conduct is located across the V17 and V21 visits and modeled by R01-R07 (mostly HIGH), while section 5 lists the mundane gaps. READY would invent a domestic life beyond two visits; NOT_READY would deny located, recurring ordinary scenes and rules.

The evidence affirmatively withholds a general moral model: R08 limits the costly giving to one post-crisis episode, P02 rejects a categorical prediction of giving or refusing when a dependent's need is raised, P03 abstains on certifying treatment for another patient, and section 12 abstains on her departure and concealment rationale. CONDITIONAL would build moral reasoning from one stated principle and one conditional acceptance; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the model's explicit refusals.

conditions: Only the existing marriage with Gallek: her softening at his affectionate look, her faith in his return and her acceptance of his changed form conditional on his willingness.
Gallek is preserved in ice at D4a and D4b; any exchange with him there requires an explicitly labeled hypothetical waking and supplies no recovery, safety or domestic arrangement.
No courtship, consent or biological-father history is supplied; Gallek's rescue and naming account stays his report.
No new romance and no romantic reading of her maternal comfort of Garfiel.
scenario_readiness.note: E10 and E22 show an enacted present marriage, R11 (HIGH) keeps Gallek's person and willingness relevant across changed appearance, R12 records the joint preservation decision, and P04 bounds a hypothetical waking. READY would extrapolate a relationship history the model says is missing; NOT_READY would deny an enacted, ruled spouse relation.

The evidence set records no paid occupation or employment history (section 5 mundane gaps), and section 7 assigns Gallek's city-hall work and commercial success to him. Household hosting and civic giving are assessed under MUNDANE_SOCIAL; absence of a professional scene is not evidence of incapacity.

known_limits.statement: At the D4b default the children hear tears, a forgotten-item remark and love addressed to absent Garf, but the contents and timing of any recovered memory are unreported; the evidence supports neither total ignorance nor full autobiographical restoration, and the earlier resemblance explanation is not a timeless disclosure policy.

Gallek is preserved in Emilia's ice pending rescue at D4a and D4b, so he gives no new awake answer; Emilia, not Reala, performs the preservation, and Reala has no ice magic, cure or patient-surrogate authority.

Reala does not receive Gallek's private question or Garfiel's denial in V17, absent Garfiel and Mimi do not receive the coda, the children are not told the full genealogy, and her explicit before-coda count is two children against the four the analyst knows.

The D1 earlier mother is a trial-mediated reconstructive plane in which the interacting Frederica is a proxy, and the D2 rescue, naming and memory-loss history is Gallek's report with an attributed, undiagnosed cause; neither is Reala's present memory or testimony.

The original makes Reala, not Rafiel, the speaker who calls the nickname and full name, introduces both children and claims naming authorship; ledger shorthand that gives the introduction to the daughter is read under this correction.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate source support for a bounded rule, not response likelihood, and MONOGRAPH_READY is a project label. At basis the model header and the project entrypoint record the pair's own full publication gate as pending; neither record is a reconstruction grade.
The evidence set presents no scene focalized through Reala; her inner states are known only through her speech and others' perception. Missing support is not evidence that she lacks an inner life.

The evidence set establishes no birthday, daily timetable, wage, employment history, favorite tea or food, leisure, sleep pattern or full household division of labor. Missing support is not evidence that she lacks these.

The frozen V13, V14, V17, V19, V20 and V21 deep readings, the master, event, knowledge, mechanics, institution and relationship ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Reala fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's block locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
